Visitor removes details/summary elements entirely

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_details(self, ctx, is_open):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "skip"
    html = "<p>Main content here.</p><details><summary>Hidden section</summary><p>Secret details</p></details><p>More main content.</p>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
